where: harness/v2/lean_gate.py and scripts/src/bin/lean_gate.rs (the two packages pin one toolchain)
what: Bumping lean/lean-toolchain alone (4.20.0 to 4.35.0) leaves lean/analysis on 4.20.0 with its Mathlib, and the gate refuses that: the packages pin different toolchains. A core-only bump cannot pass the gate.
cost: a lane scoped to the core package cannot reach a green gate on its own
cause: one rule ties both packages to one pin while lean/analysis carries a Mathlib built for one exact Lean release
workaround: bump lean/analysis (toolchain, Mathlib rev, lake-manifest) in the same batch before the gate runs
